reviewer.note: docs/reviews/2026-11-04-woodland-water.md, round 9 (ce83b70a). Still rocks.sheet, the woodland's painter; the woodland's ground, flow and rill are byte-identical to 3b200eaa. Picture = frame 0 and the flow strip = frames 0-7 on every sheet texel; the bakes hold the picture exactly. All 8 frames measured: value passes on the ribbon in every frame; grain ratio 6.5-11.2, median run 7-16 (K5-1 floors 4 and 6; the 13 world px streak cap did not bring back the chip mosaic). Navy band in the upper three quarters never more than a texel over min(0.15 w, 9); largest water-1 patch at most 8.8 texels a row. K8-1 fixed: crest runs 9, 2, 8, 9, 23 (gaps 3, 5, 4, 4), whitest row 0.58-0.60. K8-2 fixed: navy band 9 (round 8: 12), patch 8.4 a row. Polish P9-1: the west half's runs 9, 8, 9 behind 4-texel gaps read as an even crenellation at 6-10x (broken water at 1x-2x).
